newsitem.title: USA: Bombay names Robert Jackson as president/CEO.
newsitem.headline: Bombay names Robert Jackson as president/CEO.

text.p: Bombay Co said Monday it had appointed one of its directors, Robert Jackson, as acting president and chief executive officer.
Jackson succeeds Carson Thompson, who has accepted similar positions at another Fort Worth company, Bombay said.
Jackson will act in the two capacities while the Bombay board searches for a new president and CEO, the specialty furniture, prints and home accessories retailer said.
Jackson is former president and chief executive of USPCI Inc, a subsidiary of Union Pacific Corp.
Thompson, a shareholder of Bombay, will continue to serve on the company's board, it said.
